blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu City Council returned the Technical Infrastructure Committee’s (TIC) report on Monterrazas de Cebu to the panel for further review after councilors questioned its recommendation to allow the development’s existing and ongoing projects to continue.
